description: This bar chart illustrates the performance of different models—Greedy (CodeLlama-7B), RPG (CodeLlama-7B), Greedy (CodeLlama-34B), and RPG (CodeLlama-34B)—across four metrics: EGP ↑, TR-N ↓, TR-S ↓, and CCP ↑. The horizontal axis represents the metrics, labeled with abbreviations and directional arrows, and is ordered as EGP, TR-N, TR-S, and CCP. The vertical axis, labeled “Performance,” displays a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. For each metric, there are four bars representing each model; “Greedy (CodeLlama-7B)” is represented by blue bars, “RPG (CodeLlama-7B)” by orange bars, “Greedy (CodeLlama-34B)” by teal bars, and “RPG (CodeLlama-34B)” by brown bars.  For the EGP metric, the brown “RPG (CodeLlama-34B)” bar is the tallest, extending to approximately 0.9, while the blue “Greedy (CodeLlama-7B)” bar is the shortest, reaching approximately 0.05.  For TR-N, the orange “RPG (CodeLlama-7B)” bar has a value of approximately 0.75, and the brown “RPG (CodeLlama-34B)” bar is approximately 0.3. For TR-S, the orange “RPG (CodeLlama-7B)” bar is again the tallest, reaching about 0.85, and the brown “RPG (CodeLlama-34B)” is the shortest at approximately 0.25. Finally, for CCP, the brown “RPG (CodeLlama-34B)” bar reaches about 0.95, while the brown “RPG (CodeLlama-34B)” bar has a value of about 0.3. The bars are arranged in groups of four, one group for each metric, and no bars appear to be visually emphasized.
